# DevSync

> A full-stack DevOps platform for secrets management, service discovery,
> and observability, built on HashiCorp Vault, Consul, Terraform, and
> Nomad, with a Next.js/Express frontend and backend.

DevSync gives engineering teams a single control plane for infrastructure
operations: Vault-backed secrets (no credentials hardcoded anywhere in the
codebase), Consul-based service discovery with automated health checks,
Prometheus metrics visualized in Grafana, log aggregation via Loki, and
Terraform-provisioned infrastructure deployed through Nomad.

## Key pages

- [Dashboard](https://devsync.app/dashboard): Live overview of request
  volume, service health (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Vault, Consul, Nomad, and
  the backend API), and recent deployment activity.

## Technical implementation

- **Secrets:** HashiCorp Vault (KV v2), with role-based access control
  enforced on every route that reads them.
- **Service discovery:** Consul, with the backend self-registering an
  HTTP health check on startup and deregistering on shutdown.
- **Observability:** Prometheus scrapes a `/metrics` endpoint exposing
  HTTP request duration histograms; Grafana is pre-provisioned with
  Prometheus and Loki data sources.
- **Infrastructure as code:** Terraform provisions Vault secrets and a
  Nomad job spec (`backend.nomad`) for the backend service.
- **Authentication:** JWT-based, with GitHub OAuth2 as an alternative
  login path.
- **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions runs lint, typecheck, unit tests, a real
  database migration against a Postgres service container, and a full
  build on every push.

Source and full documentation: https://github.com/Younique98/devsync
